hook.name: CrimeFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for CRIME token pools that enforces a market-cap-based dynamic fee ladder, taking protocol and creator fees on each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas (minted as ERC-6909 claims), and distributing them to configurable destinations: a funds recipient, buyback-burn (swaps native fees for launch tokens and burns them), liquidity donation, and a diamond-cut vault.
